title: PERFLUOROALKYLTIN(IV) HALIDES: A NOVEL PERFLUOROALKYLATING AGENT FOR CARBONYL COMPOUNDS
abstract: Abstract                Perfluoroalkyltin(IV) halides (RfSnX2I) were prepared in situ by the oxidative addition of perfluoroalkyl iodides to tin(II) halide in N,N-dimethylformamide. Aldehydes and ketones readily reacted with RfSnCl2I giving perfluoroalkylcarbinols in the N,N-dimethylformamide-pyridine system. RfSnF2I, however, did not undergo the reactions with these carbonyl compounds.
